subject.title: Proof stack for generated media wake-false fallback

question: What proof should be required before this generated-media wake-false stack can move forward?
rationale: The branch is intentionally proof-only, the current artifact skipped both lanes, and choosing whether scheduler-level evidence or visible Telegram proof is sufficient requires maintainer acceptance of the proof boundary.

options.title: Require Combined Live Proof
options.body: Keep this draft open until a redacted Telegram Desktop artifact, terminal output, or logs show main missing or blocking the marker image and the candidate delivering exactly one image.

options.title: Accept Internal-Path Proof
options.body: Maintainers can accept source-level scheduler proof plus the Mantis manifest style as sufficient and proceed with the split PRs without visible image media proof.

options.title: Retire The Stack
options.body: Close or pause this draft once proof is captured, or if maintainers decide the split PRs should proceed without this stacked target.

recommendation.title: Require Combined Live Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this draft open until a redacted Telegram Desktop artifact, terminal output, or logs show main missing or blocking the marker image and the candidate delivering exactly one image.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest recent owner signal for the Telegram proof-runner and proof-harness files involved in the proof-sufficiency question.
